about: Walking on Waves is a north Devon surf school with a hut at the top of the slipway at Saunton Sands. It teaches beginners to advanced surfers in small groups, private lessons and short one-to-one sessions for children. It also offers multi-lesson courses and a coach-and-ride option for more experienced surfers.
offers: Coach and Ride (ages 10+, with kit hire for the day)
where: Hut at the top of the slipway, Saunton Sands Car Park, Braunton EX33 1LG
goodToKnow: All kit is included, plus a 10–15 minute beach safety talk
Arrive 20 minutes early; indoor changing and storage available
Instructors are ISA qualified and hold beach lifeguard qualifications
gaps: No season or cancellation terms stated.
